fact: The 2022 ARMDS annual report states that SIGMAP is the system under which DGMP-DSP controls contracts, that the regulator had no 'regulator access' to SIGMAP (blocking its audit application), and that the regulation portal was delayed; it records 4,557 contracts worth 523,508,573,373 FCFA in 2022 (no online share).
title: Rapport annuel 2022
publisher: Autorité de Régulation des Marchés Publics et des Délégations de Service Public (ARMDS)
